A guard for calls from unknown numbers
Scammers call pretending to be your bank, the police or a courier, then ask for an OTP, ask you to forward calls, merge a call or install a screen-sharing app.
When an unknown number calls, Scam Call Guard watches what happens on your phone around that call and warns you in real time if it looks like a scam. Everything is checked on this phone.
Our privacy promise
Phone numbers are stored only as one-way codes (hashes) and shown masked. Nothing is uploaded: this version of the app has no internet access at all.
Permissions

SMS lets us notice that an OTP or debit message arrived. Phone and contacts let us check whether a caller is unknown. Notifications let us warn you. You can deny any of these; protection will be limited and the Health screen explains what is missing.
You can change all of this later in Health & permissions.
On this Android version, open your Phone app settings and choose Scam Call Guard as the Caller ID & spam app if your phone offers it. Otherwise caller numbers are read from the call state.
Keep protection running
Samsung: Settings › Apps › Scam Call Guard › Battery › Unrestricted.
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: Settings › Apps › Manage apps › Scam Call Guard › Autostart on, Battery saver › No restrictions.
Oppo / Realme / OnePlus: Settings › Battery › App battery management › Scam Call Guard › Allow background activity and Auto launch.
Vivo / iQOO: Settings › Battery › Background power consumption › Allow; i Manager › App manager › Autostart on.
Events only (required)
Notice events such as an OTP arriving, a debit, forwarding switched on, and score them on this phone.
Voice layer (experimental)

With the call on speaker, listen for scam phrases like \"arrest\" or \"share OTP\". Nothing is recorded or stored; only the matched phrase type is kept. The other person on the call is also heard, so use it only where that is lawful.
Help improve detection
Allow sharing event scores (never text or audio) to improve detection. Not used in this build, which has no internet access.
Case sharing
Allow building a complaint pack you can share with cybercrime.gov.in or your bank.
